cradle-val-missing: Validation badge status label indicating that a required property is currently missing a value.
cradle-val-optional-missing: Validation badge status label indicating that an optional property is currently unset.
cradle-val-optional-present: Validation badge status label indicating that an optional property has a value present.
cradle-val-present: Validation badge status label indicating that a mandatory property has a valid value present.
cradle-validate-shex-btn: Button label to trigger syntax validation of the ShEx code in the editor.
cradle-validation-error: Header text for the validation error list alert displayed before saving an item.
cradle-validation-summary:
Summary text displayed in the validation banner showing required and optional property coverage.
Parameters:
* $1 - Schema ID or template name
* $2 - Number of required properties with values
* $3 - Total number of required properties defined by the schema. Supports PLURAL.
* $4 - Number of optional properties with values
* $5 - Total number of optional properties defined by the schema. Supports PLURAL.
cradle-validation-tab: Tab label for the schema validation panel in the Cradle drawer.
cradle-validation-title: Section title for the schema validation status overview.
cradle-valtype-datetime: Dropdown option label for properties taking ISO date/time literals (xsd:dateTime).
cradle-valtype-decimal: Dropdown option label for properties taking numerical decimal or quantity values (xsd:decimal).
cradle-valtype-geo: Dropdown option label for properties taking geographic coordinates in WKT format (geo:wktLiteral).
cradle-valtype-label: Field label for the datatype selector in the Schema Designer property row.
cradle-valtype-langstring: Dropdown option label for properties taking monolingual text strings with language tags (rdf:langString).
cradle-valtype-qid: Dropdown option label for properties taking Wikidata item entities (QID IRI references).
cradle-valtype-string: Dropdown option label for properties taking plain text string literals (xsd:string).
cradle-valtype-subshape: Dropdown option label for properties whose values conform to another nested ShEx sub-schema (@<SubShape> or IMPORT EntitySchema).
cradle-view-on-map: Button label to open geographic coordinates on an interactive map view.
